message.realscale.lotm.skills.seer.9: Seer (Sequence 9): sense occult creature variants; use the pendulum to detect nearby occult ores and plants.
message.realscale.lotm.skills.seer.8: Clown (Sequence 8): improved coordination; when a fall becomes dangerous, briefly slows descent.
message.realscale.lotm.skills.mystery_pr: Mystery Pryer (S9): primary surveys occult ores and herbs; secondary senses living supernatural signatures and grants short night vision.
Melee Scholar (Sequence 8): broader mineral and creature surveys; gains night vision in dark places.
Sleepless (Sequence 9): night vision and mobility at night; senses nearby hostile creatures.
Midnight Poet (Sequence 8): improved brief recovery and slows nearby hostile creatures when focusing.
message.realscale.lotm.skills.corpse_col: Corpse Collector (S9): primary senses undead and resists freezing; secondary wraps the user in a brief protective, restorative shroud.
Gravedigger (S8): primary weakens nearby undead; secondary improves the duration of a protective shroud.

message.realscale.lotm.guide.creatures: Creatures: Ten active supernatural species each have a habitat and unique material drop. The five S9 species include Starlit Squid, Nightmare Eye, Night Owl, Black-Spotted Frog and Shroudman. The five S8 species include Hornacis Goat, Ironarm Beast, Four-Eyed Turtle, Crimson Howler and Death Crow. Use pathway senses and keep your research journal.
message.realscale.lotm.guide.flora: Flora: Midnight Bloom, Face Rose, Soul-Calling Bellflower and Graveyard Blood Rose are rare biome-linked plants. Their harvests are used in S9/S8 potion recipes. Collect new species in the wild; placing and breaking harvested flowers does not award fieldwork.
message.realscale.lotm.guide.minerals: Minerals: Six active ores are Stellar Crystal, Cursed Crystal, Grave Crystal, Lunar Mica, Echo Quartz and Abyssal Salt. Seek their distinct habitats underground. Pickaxes, Silk Touch and Fortune follow ore rules. Spirit Quartz belongs to the archived S7 tier and does not naturally generate.
message.realscale.lotm.guide.alchemy: Alchemy: Put the required ingredients in the four input slots of an Occult Alchemical Apparatus. Supply Spirit Ember in the fuel slot and leave output space. Prepared S9 potions take 120 ticks, S8 potions take 240 by default. Pathway skill manuals use a book, Occult Catalyst, a pathway material and a binder; craft them here and read them to improve mastery.
message.realscale.lotm.guide.progression: Progression: Start in S9 with a pathway potion, digest it through exploration, skills, unique research and natural-resource fieldwork, then prepare the same pathway's S8 potion. Daily category caps are 12 + 8 + 9 + 6 = 35. Use /lotm panel, /lotm acting, /lotm skills, /lotm materials and /lotm journal. Read matching skill manuals to improve mastery without bypassing pathway authorization.
